item.text: {"text":"Rev 4 goal: spectrum-export validator handoff. Never overwrite raw captures. CSV columns 1–2: wavelength_nm, intensity_counts, in that order. Missing calibration stays UNKNOWN; never use zero. Acceptance limit: 8.50 counts; 12.0 is superseded. Trial: 9.10 counts; it fails. Earlier pass claim is withdrawn. Minimum exposure: 0.50 ms. Exception: batch K9 can use 0.20 ms only at temperature ≤18.0 °C, including exactly 18.0 °C. Above 18.0 °C, use 0.50 ms. Other batches always use 0.50 ms. Rev 4 is untested; release is on hold pending verification. Noise finding is unresolved; cause is unknown. Proposed cable cause is untested and not established."}
